title: MonetizeKit agent policy
description: Single source of truth for every agent role in the fleet: which model runs it, through which route, with which tools, over which data, how autonomously per environment, and who owns it. Workflows and applications resolve model IDs from this file; nothing else may pin one.

policy_version.description: Bumped on every change. Consumers print it beside their output so a finding can be traced to the policy that produced it.

review_due.description: The model-usage maintenance loop opens a model-usage-drift issue when this date has passed.

anthropic_compatible_base_url.description: Base URL callers export as ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL when a role's route is gateway and the runtime speaks the Anthropic API (claude-code-action, claude -p).

tiers.description: Named cost tiers. A role references a tier so the model-usage loop can tell 'we chose the cheap tier' from 'we forgot to upgrade'.

modelId.description: Gateway-style model ID (provider/model). Callers that speak a provider API directly strip the provider prefix with the resolver's `bare` output.

autonomy.description: act: may change state (merge, deploy, write) without a human. propose: opens a PR or issue a human accepts. prepare-only: assembles evidence and drafts, never opens or changes anything. read-only: observes and reports. none: does not run in this environment.

dataClass.description: customer-pii is never permitted for a model role; it exists so a violation is expressible and therefore testable.

model_selection.description: policy: the model below is mandatory. operator: an interactive session chooses its own model; this policy governs only tools, data and autonomy. none: deterministic role, no model.

models.description: All listed models must agree for the role to approve; they must span at least two providers.

route.description: gateway: AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY through the Vercel AI Gateway. direct-anthropic: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. cursor-cloud-agent: launched as a Cursor Cloud Agent or Automation (credential and model managed there). none: deterministic.

tools.description: Allowed tool patterns in claude-code-action syntax, e.g. Bash(git*), Read, Grep, Glob, Write. Empty means the role has no tool access (pure completion).

human_gate.description: True when a human must accept this role's output before it has effect. Required true for any role whose production autonomy is above read-only.

surfaces.description: Where this role is consumed: repo-relative paths (repo:path) so the model-usage loop can find every consumer.

prompt_version_env.description: Environment variable that carries the prompt version in the consuming workflow (checked by model-watch for bump hygiene).

evals_fixture.description: Path to the agent-evals fixture that exercises this role; model-watch flags a policy role with none.
